text:
The light of memory is cold

what was barely glimpsed shines

with insistence

turns, seeking the bottle shard

or the rain puddle


behind any door that opens

is the moon

so large and flat

so out of place

as if it were a painting

oil on paper

hardened by time


thus they fell into the mind

forms and colors

coincidences

chance that knots shadows

upheavals in the black cauldron

where in bubbling surges

joy and dread are cooked


the plaster of a sky grows

wounded a thousand times

whitened a thousand times

the world is erased and written

again

to the last breath


only this

apparent eternity

wretched splinter of light in

the entrail

of the animal

that barely was

translation.title: The Light Is Cold
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Varela's spare syntax and the memory image as a cold splinter inside a nearly vanished animal.
